readiness_note: Backend authority is real, tested and persistent. The B01 client still needs to send session_ref on GET /snapshot and a command_ref on POST /command; neither was changed this round because the Godot project was out of scope.

audit_gaps_closed.how: Adapter translates the absolute target into the core MOVE_VECTOR authority (collision gate + step_vector). No movement rule reimplemented.
Every route resolves the actor from the core v15_godot_sessions row. A client-supplied session that is unknown/revoked is rejected and inert.
Persisted monotonic integer per session in s16b_snapshot_cursor; survives process restart.
command_ref idempotency key journalled in s16b_command_journal; replays are answered from the journal and never reapplied.

audit_gaps_closed.gap: strict rejection of client-supplied authority fields
audit_gaps_closed.how: Recursive server-side scan of the whole envelope; mirrors and extends the andromeda_bridge.gd guard.
IntegratedARPGEngineV16A with Stage16A health gate PASS at boot.

corrections_found.finding: The historical living_api.py ignores the client session_ref and substitutes the hard-coded GODOT-FASTAPI-001, which is why wrong-session probes passed. The core GodotIsometricAdapterV15 already rejects unknown sessions correctly.
corrections_found.resolution: Session validation is delegated to the existing core instead of being reinvented.

corrections_found.finding: ContinuousMovementSystem.step_vector has no event_ref and no idempotency, unlike every ARPG core. Two identical MOVE_VECTOR calls apply twice.
corrections_found.resolution: Replay suppression owned by the transport layer via command_ref journal; core idempotency is preserved where it exists (future commands pass command_ref through as the core event_ref).

corrections_found.finding: godot_adapter_v15.py cannot receive MOVE_TO_POINT: it is inside the 724-entry protected Stage16A checkpoint, verified byte-identical.
corrections_found.resolution: MOVE_TO_POINT implemented in the new adapter as parameter translation over MOVE_VECTOR. Zero protected bytes changed.

corrections_found.finding: Stage15/Stage16A runners default to /mnt/data Linux master paths and 03_TESTS runners do not put 01_RUNTIME on sys.path.
corrections_found.resolution: Normalised at the configuration layer (ANDROMEDA_MASTER_RELEASE + PYTHONPATH set by run_stage16b_authority_validation.py) rather than by editing protected test files.

corrections_found.finding: The phantom Master V2.1.0 paths live in the protected historical Living V1.5 tree (LIVING_COUNTRY_SCALE_WORK/.../03_TESTS), not in the Stage16A project.
corrections_found.resolution: Not edited. The Stage16B authority path refuses any V2.1.0 token or hash at configuration time; living_runtime SUPPORTED_MASTER_RELEASES already accepts V2.0.1 only.

risks: Single-process authority: the SQLite world requires --workers 1. A second worker would corrupt session/cursor ordering.
Cold bootstrap costs ~20 s; any client health poll must tolerate that window.
The MOVE_TO_POINT step duration is sized using a mirror of the core env-factor clamp (0.25..1.25) and duration band (0, 10]. Test test_37 pins those bands against the live core so drift fails loudly.
The adapter var/ directory holds a real persistent world; deleting it silently creates a new world_instance_id on next boot.
No authentication on the HTTP surface. It binds 127.0.0.1 only and must not be exposed beyond loopback.

blockers.summary: andromeda_bridge.gd request_snapshot() issues GET /snapshot with no session_ref, so the server cannot validate the session.
blockers.fix: Append ?session_ref=<session.session_ref()> or send the X-Andromeda-Session header.

blockers.summary: The command envelope carries no idempotency key, so a transport retry is indistinguishable from a legitimate repeat.
blockers.fix: Add a stable command_ref per intent, reused across retries of the same envelope.

blockers.summary: ClientSession.bind_session only sets a local cursor; nothing calls the server to open the session.
blockers.fix: POST /session/bind with the chosen session_ref before the first snapshot.
